sloka: असुरैः वा सुरैः वा त्वम् यदि अवध्यो असि रावण ।उत्पाद्य सुमहत् वैरम् जीवन् तस्य न मोक्ष्यसे ॥३-५६-८॥
transliteration: asuraiḥ vā suraiḥ vā tvam yadi avadhyo asi rāvaṇa ।utpādya sumahat vairam jīvan tasya na mokṣyase ॥3-56-8॥

translations.english: O Ravana, even if you stand invulnerable to gods and demons, you will not come out alive in the combat with Rama with whom you have earned great enmity.
